entity.name: Selçuk Güral
entity.description: Designer and maintainer of SG, a small systems programming language. SG is a non-profit open source project that lives on donations.

projects.name: SG
projects.description: SG is a small systems programming language: about as small and as fast as C, memory safe like Rust, and written in a notation that reads like C#. The project includes the language design, a checker, an interpreter and a back end that compiles through C.
